The story

I grew up at Jacksonville Beach, where fishing, surfing and having fun all revolved around the tides.

This print tells the future story of 2027. The moon sets the pace. The seasons push the tides to their highs and lows.

How to read it

Full moon or new moon? Scoot your towel back.

Each line is one day, from low tide to high tide. January starts at the top and the year runs clockwise. A longer line means a bigger swing. Solid discs are full moons. Dashed rings are new moons.

The printBuyingShippingIf something’s wrongWhat’s next

The print

  • What’s on it?

    Every tide of 2027

    All 365 days of tides at Jacksonville Beach, drawn as one ring around the beach. It’s 18 x 24 in, printed on thick matte paper and shipped unframed.

  • How do I read it?

    One line, one day

    Each line runs from that day’s low tide to its high tide. A longer line means a bigger swing. January sits at the top, and the year runs clockwise. Solid discs are full moons. Dashed rings are new moons.

    The tides are NOAA’s predictions for station 8720291, the Jacksonville Beach pier. Wind and storms move real tides around, so enjoy it on the wall, not at the boat ramp.

  • Will it fit my frame?

    Any 18 x 24 frame

    It fits a standard 18 x 24 in frame, sold at most frame and craft stores. No trimming needed.

Buying

  • What does it cost?

    $70, shipping free

    Prices are in US dollars. Sales tax, if any, shows at checkout before you pay. Nothing else gets added.

  • Is checkout safe?

    Yes, it runs on Stripe

    Stripe handles your card, and I never see your card number. Apple Pay and Google Pay work. No account needed.

  • Can I send it as a gift?

    Yes

    Enter their address at checkout and it ships straight to them. For Christmas, order by December 10.

  • Can I change or cancel my order?

    Within 12 hours

    Within 12 hours of ordering, email me at hello@tarverart.com or DM me on Instagram at @tarver.art. If it hasn’t gone to print, I’ll change or cancel it and refund you in full. After that, it’s already being made for you.

Shipping

  • When will it get here?

    Usually 1 to 2 weeks

    It’s printed for you within 5 business days, then spends 3 to 8 business days in the mail. You’ll get a tracking link by email when it ships.

  • Where do you ship?

    Anywhere in the US

    All 50 states, free. I don’t ship outside the US yet.

  • It came rolled. Now what?

    Unroll it and frame it

    It can go straight into a poster hanger or a frame with plexiglass, right out of the tube.

    For the flattest result, lay it on a hard, flat surface, not carpet, with a few books on top overnight. Then frame it.

If something’s wrong

  • It arrived damaged or printed wrong.

    I’ll replace it, free

    Within 30 days of delivery, email me at hello@tarverart.com or DM me on Instagram at @tarver.art with a photo. Pick a new print or a full refund. No need to send anything back.

  • It never showed up.

    I’ll track it down

    Check your tracking link first. Still nothing 30 days after the expected date? Email me at hello@tarverart.com or DM me on Instagram at @tarver.art. I’ll send a new one or refund you.

  • Can I return it?

    Only if something’s wrong

    Each print is made just for you, so I can’t take returns for a change of mind. Anything damaged, misprinted or lost is on me. The full policy is in Shipping and returns.

What’s next

Privacy

What I collect, why, and who else sees it.

In short

  • I collect only what I need to make and ship your print.
  • I never see or store your card number. Stripe does.
  • I never sell or rent your information.
  • Ask me to see or delete it any time.

Who I am

This site is run by Aaron Tarver, an artist in Jacksonville, Florida. “I” means me.

What I collect

  • When you buy: your name, email, shipping address and phone number if you give one. Stripe collects these at checkout.
  • When you join the collector list: your email.
  • When you visit: basic visit data, like pages viewed, device type and the ad or link that brought you, through cookies.

How I use it

  • To make, ship and support your order.
  • To email you about new pieces, if you joined the list.
  • To learn which ads and links work.

Who else sees it

Only the services that run this shop, each under its own privacy policy:

  • Stripe takes your payment.
  • Printful prints and ships your order, so it gets your name and address.
  • Kit stores the collector list and sends its emails.
  • Meta measures my Facebook and Instagram ads through its pixel.
  • Cloudflare hosts this site.

No one else gets your information. I don’t sell or rent it.

Cookies

The Meta pixel uses cookies to measure ads. You can block cookies in your browser and the site still works. You can also limit ads in your Facebook or Instagram ad settings.

Emails

Every collector list email has an unsubscribe link. Order emails, like your receipt and tracking, still come.

How long I keep it

Order records stay as long as tax law requires. Your collector list email stays until you unsubscribe.

Your choices

To see, correct or delete your information, email me at hello@tarverart.com or DM me on Instagram at @tarver.art. I’ll take care of it within 30 days.

Kids

Kids are welcome to look at the art. Buying and joining the collector list are for adults. I don’t knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you think I have, email me at hello@tarverart.com or DM me on Instagram at @tarver.art and I’ll delete it.

Changes

If this policy changes, the date at the top changes too.

Questions?Email me at hello@tarverart.com or DM me on Instagram at @tarver.art. I answer every message myself, within 48 hours.
